summary.content:
Today's selection covers 80 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 51 on Artificial Intelligence and 17 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: How Do You Use A.I. for Daily Life?
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: New KadNap botnet hijacks ASUS routers to fuel cybercrime proxy network
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, BBC Technology, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 64 articles published in the last 24 hours
